traps.description: The text holds no price; every price statement is wrong. Storage sizes and limits are not prices.

notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL. A help-center article about the Standard plan whose FAQ answers "How much does Dropbox Standard cost?" with a non-answer ("determined by several factors, including the number of members and your geographic location"). Storage amounts (3 TB, 1 TB, 5 TB) and "100 GB" transfer limits are not prices.
